messages:
Priya (product): Heads up 1:30 - planning a compact thread to agree pricing + SLO mapping for the 'vertical benchmark' add-on. Need quick decisions for the pilot.

Ethan: TL;DR: keep default fast & free, charge for per-customer benchmark + migration runway. Pricing options: flat bundle, or time-and-materials.

Maya (sales): Customers prefer predictable fee not T&M. Suggested entry: $8k for a single vertical benchmark + 4-week runway, or enterprise package with credits.

Carlos (eng): cost side: a 2-week dedicated slot for bench + 2-week canary can eat a Dedicated GPU node for the window. Rough infra cost estimate: $2.2k/node/week in our accounting (varies by region).

Priyanka (legal): we must be explicit in contract: what we guarantee (bench results, runbook delivery, compatibility report) and what we don't (model retraining, customer data prep). Also need IP & data handling clauses for customer benchmarks.

Priya (product): Proposal: two SKUs
- Benchmark Lite: $4k, 1-week bench (smoke + perf), no pin guarantees, 72h smoke SLA
- Benchmark Plus: $9k, 4-week runway (bench+tuning+canary), optional 90-day pin add-on for $3k
(Mention: price examples, negotiable on ARR)

Ethan: suggest we tie SLOs to SKU. Lite -> no SLA, expected p95 best-effort; Plus -> committed performance SLO for the duration of runway (we provide remediation guidance).

Carlos (eng): technical mapping idea:
```
Lite:
  infra: shared bucket
  tests: automated perf smoke + stability
  deliverable: perf profile + quick-check
Plus:
  infra: reserved slot (node reservation)
  tests: full benchmark + KV stress tests + canary automation
  deliverable: compatibility report + rollback playbook
```
Note: pinned variants require dedicated provisioning.

Maya (sales): Customers ask if SLO can be SLA-backed (credits) for Plus. We can do a credit-based SLA for a narrow set of metrics (p95 latency, availability) but legal needs to sign off.

Priyanka (legal): We can offer credits but cap liability. Need a cut-and-dry metric definition, measurement window, and excluded incidents (third-party infra, customer misconfig).

Priya (product): Let's define the SLOs for Plus pilot:
- p95 latency (region-specific): target and tolerance band
- success_rate: >= 99.5% during canary window
- regression_tolerance: <= 2% accuracy delta vs customer baseline
We should param thresholds by hardware bucket.

Ethan: Also include a cost-recovery clause: if we must reserve a node and customer cancels inside runway, we charge a cancellation fee (eg. 50%).

Carlos (eng): ops note: need an API flag to mark a model as "pinned_for_customer:<customer-id>" so routing respects pins. Minimal change but impacts routing and capacity. Ops team needs lead time to schedule Dedicated slots.

Priyanka (legal): Contract language: we will provide a "compatibility report" and defined remediation recommendations. Any remediation work beyond recommendations will be quoted separately.

Priya (product): Action items:
- Maya: validate price points with 3 customers by EOD Fri
- Ethan: build cost model (infra + engineering hours) and propose margin target
- Carlos: spec minimal API change for pin flag and estimate eng time
- Priyanka: draft contract appendix language for benchmark add-on
- Priya: finalize SLO definitions param by hardware bucket

deploy-bot: Note: created ticket BENCH-PILOT-102 for bookkeeping.

Maya (sales): I'll push back on the $4k floor for fintech, they might accept $6k. Will update.

Ethan: I'll share excel with calc assumptions. aim for gross margin >= 50% on Pilot SKU.

Carlos (eng): API flag spec: approx 3 dev days + 1 day infra; will file ENG-1823.

Priyanka (legal): I'll post a short appendix draft tomorrow AM.

Priya (product): Cool. We need sign-off by next Tue to include in pilot launch doc. If anyone can't make Tue sync, add comments to BENCH-PILOT-102. Thanks all :shipit:
